content: Ishaan Bose called Sunita Agarwal at Protect All Agency to inquire about his health policy expiration date of 30/09/2026 and the consequences of expiration. Sunita explained that coverage ends on that date unless renewed or switched to a new plan. Ishaan requested the renewal brochure to review with his employer before making a decision.

action_items: Email the renewal brochure to the customer
